title: Domain Owners Must Coordinate DNSSEC Signing and Delegation

cover.subtitle: Keep signing keys and parent records aligned.
cover.visual: Two small cards, parent DS and child DNSKEY, joined by a short verification link. Compact strip no taller than130pixels and strictlyinsidey310-450.

sections.name: 01-understand-the-trust-relationship-before-enabling-signatures
sections.heading: DNSSEC validation requires a complete trust relationship
sections.scene: Two cards exactly Parent DS and Child DNSKEY connected by a verification line. A separate signed answer card has a small signature icon. No encryption padlock or privacy claims.
sections.alt: DNSSEC validation requires a complete trust relationship.

sections.name: 02-prepare-a-complete-deployment-and-verify-the-result
sections.heading: A complete deployment verifies signing and parent records
sections.scene: A DNS operator publishes a signed zone card. A separate registrar account submits a parent DS card. A third verification card checks the relationship. No numeric example keys.
sections.alt: A complete deployment verifies signing and parent records.

sections.name: 03-coordinate-dnssec-during-provider-and-key-changes
sections.heading: Provider changes require a coordinated DNSSEC transition
sections.scene: Old DNS operator and New DNS operator cards sit side by side, with a separate Parent DS card above. A checklist between the cards indicates coordinated migration, no fixed step arrows or timing claims.
sections.alt: Provider changes require a coordinated DNSSEC transition.

sections.name: 04-investigate-validation-failures-without-hiding-the-cause
sections.heading: A validation investigation identifies the failed relationship
sections.scene: An amber broken link lies between Parent DS and Child DNSKEY cards. A magnifying glass inspects that link, while website and mail record cards remain unchanged beside it.
sections.alt: A validation investigation identifies the failed relationship.

purpose: Initial illustration plan. The final image review manifest records actual asset hashes and visual revisions.
